description: This is a C# source file defining a class HttpService that provides HTTP client functionalities such as GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE, including error handling and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates HTTP operations for making API calls with support for JSON serialization, error handling, and toast notifications.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URI and deserializes the response into the specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request for a specified resource identified by ID and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with the provided data serialized as JSON and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with the provided data serialized as JSON and deserializes the response.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object into JSON string content suitable for HTTP transmission.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Deserializes the content of an HTTP response message into the specified type.
